instructions: roxum is a Web platform for Roc with a Zig host. Keep application policy and pure transformations in Roc and operating-system resources in the host. Code comments and documentation are written in English, except explicitly localized documents such as README.ja.md. Comments should explain contracts, invariants, constraints, or non-obvious reasons, not restate the code or record development history.

files.description: Repository conventions, language rules, and verification expectations
Rules for pure and effectful Roc functions, -> and =>, and the ! naming convention
Ownership and lifetime contracts for request allocations and effect handles
Suspension and cancellation contracts for I/O scheduling
Which modules and types are application-visible

rules.rule: Do not use inferred enum literals such as .persistent or .request in project-authored Zig code. Qualify values with their type, for example Domain.persistent.
Request allocations and effect handles must not escape their request lifetime.
Follow roc_coding_rules.md: pure functions use ->, effectful functions use => and end their names with !.
Do not expose host implementation types in the public Roc API merely because ABI glue needs them.
When public behavior changes, the relevant guides, examples, and contract tests should change in the same pull request, including error behavior.
README.md and README.ja.md must stay aligned when their shared content changes.
